channel.title: The Logical Indian - Article Feed
channel.description: Latest articles from The Logical Indian (thelogicalindian.com)

item.title: Taxi driver’s son Deepak Kandpal from Bageshwar’s Rented Room Wins President’s Gold Medal as NDA 149th Top Cadet
item.description: Deepak Kandpal, from Uttarakhand's modest roots, excels in academics, fitness, and leadership to claim NDA's highest honour.

item.title: India Clinches Victory Over Nepal at Inaugural Unity Cup 2025 Wheelchair Basketball Championship
item.description: India's wheelchair basketball team secured a 60-51 victory over Nepal in the opening match of the historic Unity Cup 2025.

item.title: IndiGo Flight Cancellations: Here’s What the New DGCA Flight-Duty Time Limitations (FDTL) Rules Mean
item.description: As DGCA’s revamped FDTL norms shrink pilot availability, IndiGo faces massive operational strain, forcing over 150 cancellations a day.

item.title: Aleema Khan Accuses Pakistan’s Army Chief of Radicalism and War Lust amid Imran Khan’s Imprisonment Fears
item.description: Imran Khan’s sister exposes deep rifts in Pakistani leadership, blaming army chief Asim Munir for escalating India tensions and threatening her brother’s safety.

item.title: Delhi Govt to Procure 10,000 Dual Desks from Tihar Jail Factory to Tackle School Furniture Shortage
item.description: Delhi government approves buying 10,000 dual desks from Tihar Jail to address shortages in schools.

item.title: INDIA Bloc Wears Gas Masks, Mocks Modi’s ‘Mausam ka maza’ as Delhi’s AQI Hits 352 in Toxic Smog Crisis
item.description: Opposition MPs protested outside Parliament on December 3, 2025, demanding urgent action on Delhi's severe air pollution, mocking PM Modi's weather remark amid AQI levels reaching 352.​

item.title: West Bengal Miracle: Stray Dogs Guard Abandoned Newborn Through Freezing Night, Baby Rescued Safe and Unharmed
item.description: A pack of stray dogs stood vigil all night around a newborn abandoned outside a toilet in West Bengal's Nabadwip, shielding him from cold until locals rescued the healthy infant.

item.title: Bomb Threat Forces IndiGo Madinah–Hyderabad Flight to Make Emergency Landing in Ahmedabad
item.description: An IndiGo flight from Madinah to Hyderabad made a precautionary landing in Ahmedabad following a bomb threat.

item.title: Surat Businessman Honours Mother’s Memory by Paying Off ₹89.89 Lakh Debts, Freeing 290+ Farmers After 30 Years of Struggle
item.description: On his mother’s death anniversary, a Surat industrialist clears three decades-old debts, helping 290 Gujarat farmers reclaim their land and livelihoods.

item.title: Arunachal Youth Group Questions Mosque Legality; Asks Muslim Cleric to Chant ‘Bharat Mata Ki Jai’ in Video
item.description: A viral video from Itanagar shows the APIYO questioning a mosque’s legality has gone viral with mixed reactions from people online.
